newsitem.title: UK: Slack offtake for raw cotton in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Slack offtake for raw cotton in Europe.

text.p: European traders find that offtake for raw cotton is slack, adding that Turkey, until recently an active buyer, has turned quiet.
Market participants assume that mills are either better covered than had been thought or are using a bigger volume of other fibres, particularly polyester on which prices are seen competitive.
Interest remains thin in purchasing new crop cotton for forward delivery.
